description: What the workflow-command-runner returns for an assignment that names its command itself (no WORKFORCE_RELAY_BINDING_V1 line): the command's exit status and its stdout, verbatim. Nothing in it is rebuilt: the workflow script (the relay shared block, scripts/shared-blocks/relay.js) checks the copy against the checksum it carries and, when the copy fails, reads the relay file the command saved instead.

exitCode.description: The exit status of the one command the assignment named.

stdout.description: The complete RELAY64v1: line the command printed, copied verbatim: every character as printed, in order, including the prefix and any trailing = characters, with nothing added, removed, reordered or re-typed. Treat its base64 payload as opaque text; never decode or reconstruct it. When the command printed more than one line, all of stdout verbatim.
